links.note: Same topic: adjusting assessment for candidate groups. CBLM 2 pp.8-9 table 'Learner Needs and Reasonable Adjustments' covers disability, older, Indigenous and gender rows like CBLM 12 pp.11-13. CBLM 2 also adds 'Ill health' (shorter tasks, longer time, scribe or audio recorder) and 'Family responsibilities' rows that CBLM 12 does not list. The low literacy row is on the CBLM 2 card low-literacy-numeracy-assessment.

Same list of reasonable adjustments to assessment methods and tools. CBLM 2 p.12 has nine items like CBLM 12 p.11; CBLM 2 joins age, gender, culture and religion into one item and adds 'arranging for a member of a client's community to be present at the assessment'.
